about: Golden audio for blinx2 audio-check (task 5.x of openspec change audio). A scenario's dump is the WAV tap RECOMP_DEBUG=audio_wav under Proton on the Linux/Proton host: exactly the samples handed to the device, 48 kHz s16 stereo. References (xemu captures, scripts/xemu_ref.py --audio) live in analysis/golden/audio/<scenario>.ref.wav, gitignored: they are game output. This file holds thresholds only. The first-sound windows and the correlation limits are provisional until task 5.5 sets them from measured runs with margin; the buffer-size table of tasks 4.3/4.6 goes here too. Wine queue A/B (openspec change audio-wine-queue, design D3; SSX 3 long bench under GE-Proton11-7 on the Deck, D3D11, 620 s, load = 7 busy loops; per run: underruns, seconds with q_min 0, q_min p1, gap_ms p99/max, flips/s). Build 82f7a42e: A count 4 loaded 972/209/0/50.7-144.8/47.4 and 1016/211/0/49.9-69.4/48.3; A idle 2/0/768/12.3-29.5/60.0 and 2/0/768/12.2-30.1/60.1; B count 6 idle 0/0/1280/19.5-29.7/60.0 and 0/0/1280/25.5-33.9/60.0; B loaded 612/167/0/45.4-55.3/47.6 and 655/184/0/47.4-60.1/47.0. Build e7e8ce3e: C count 4 highest loaded 947/205/0/48.0-61.1/46.1 and 1065/217/0/49.4-62.4/45.7; D count 6 highest loaded 713/196/0/47.2-79.6/46.0 and 687/174/0/46.5-65.6/45.2; A same build loaded 1055/242/0/47.3-65.0/46.6; E count 8 loaded 513/144/0/49.5-80.4/45.5 and 472/122/0/45.9-97.7/47.1; E idle 0/0/2048/10.2-31.4/60.0 and 0/0/1792/26.7-49.0/59.9. Frame-thread lock wait stayed under 1 ms with no wait of 8 ms or more; trap spells 0. Outcome: Wine default count 6 (smallest clean idle); highest is a no-op on a stock Deck (RLIMIT_NICE 0); every count drains under load, so the loaded gate is fewer underruns than every count-4 loaded run (947).

compare.method: first sample at or above silence_floor_dbfs inside the scenario's first_sound_window (seconds from the start of the dump); no run of digital zero longer than max_dropout_ms between the first and last sound with sound at or above silence_floor_dbfs in the 50 ms on each side of it; clipped-sample share at most max_clipping_fraction; with the log, |frames / (48000 x submit seconds) - 1| at most rate_tolerance; with a reference, envelope lag inside +/- max_lag_ms, envelope correlation at least min_envelope_correlation, and every non-silent band's correlation (8 bands, 50 Hz-16 kHz, 1 s windows) at least min_band_correlation; noise: at most max_noise_fraction of the 1 s windows at or above silence_floor_dbfs may be noise-like, that is spectral flatness (200 Hz-16 kHz) >= noise_flatness and at least noise_hf_share of the energy above 8 kHz -- white noise is ~0.56 flatness with two thirds of its energy up there, music under 0.3 and a few percent; this is the check that catches the APU playing memory that is not audio (the dumps that did had flatness 0.40-0.51 and 57-67 % above 8 kHz; five clean runs, title and in-game, peak at 0.315 and 16 %, so 0.36 / 0.25 leave a margin on both sides). A scenario with sustained broadband effects may carry its own noise_flatness / noise_hf_share / max_noise_fraction (a scenario's keys override these), set from a run known good by ear
